 This Appeal, Coming On For Admission, This Day,
The Court Delivered The Following:
 Judgment
1. The Insurer is in appeal challenging the award of compensation of Rs.1,50,150/- for the injuries suffered by one Nithin, a 21 year old.
2. It is the contention of the Insurer that the driver of the offending vehicle did not possess a driving licence.

It is also contended that the driving licence number furnished indicated that it belonged to a person other than the chargesheeted driver and therefore, the liability could not be fastened on the Insurer.

3. In my view, since the Insurer contends that there has been a violation of the policy conditions, the insurer would nevertheless have to pay the compensation and thereafter recover the same from the owner of the offending vehicle.

4. In this view of the matter, the appeal of the Insurer is dismissed, however, with a modification of the order of the Tribunal to the effect that the Insurer shall pay the compensation and thereafter,
proceed to recover the same from the owner of the offending vehicle.
5. The amount in deposit, if any, shall be transferred to the Tribunal.
